title: Building interactive websites is becoming less about writing code. And more about describing ideas.
description:
AI-powered development tools are rapidly lowering the barrier to creating immersive web experiences. What once required a team of designers and developers can now begin with a single prompt, making advanced technologies like 3D interfaces and interactive animations accessible to far more creators.

The biggest shift isn't that AI can build websites.

It's that it lets people spend more time designing experiences and less time wrestling with implementation.

As these tools continue to improve, the competitive advantage won't be knowing every framework.

It will be knowing what to build and how to create experiences people remember.
